narrative_summary: Q1 2026 earnings reported recently: Revenue $173M (+~20% YoY), security revenue +47% YoY to $38.8M (22% of total, 4th consecutive quarter of accelerating security growth), adjusted EPS 50% above consensus, FY26 guide raised to $710M-$725M. Pre-earnings rally was driven by AI Accelerator launch, LALIGA AI anti-piracy partnership, and expectations of move to non-GAAP profitability. Despite the beat and raise, shares fell ~39% post-earnings due to lower-than-expected QoQ core delivery volumes and stretched expectations after 270% three-month rally. Next earnings likely Aug 2026 (typical Q2 cadence).
